Moby Bikes API

Dublin City Council cc-by · last updated 2025-12-17T22:56:41.091382

Dublin's Moby bike-share fleet operates almost entirely as general-service bikes, with 94% in standard circulation and only 6% in workshop or private use

  • The 'DUB-General' category accounts for 18,826 of the 20,000 recorded bike states (94%), with 'Workshop' bikes representing just 939 observations (4.7%) and 'Private' bikes only 235 (1.2%)
  • When measured by total BikeID occurrences, the DUB-General category dominates with 1,133,122 records — 97% ahead of the Workshop category's 35,741 records
  • Over 15% of longitude coordinates (3,017 of 20,000 readings) fall outside normal geographic boundaries, suggesting bikes occasionally move beyond the expected Dublin service area or experience GPS errors
  • Battery levels average 67% across the fleet with a standard deviation of 18 percentage points, though 5.6% of readings (1,122 values) are statistical outliers, including some negative values as low as -6%
A caveat worth knowing: This is a five-day snapshot from October 2020 tracking 94 unique bikes with GPS updates every five minutes; it does not capture longer-term fleet growth, seasonal patterns, or the full operational history of the scheme
Source & method

Dataset on data.gov.ie: https://data.gov.ie/dataset/moby-bikes
